source_school: Harvard College Dean of Students Office Staff
bio: I work with Chip Lockwood, our Resident Dean, to support Adams students with all administrative details related to their academic lives, including pass/fail forms, independent study, study abroad, advanced standing, letters of recommendation, Commencement, Ad Board petitions (for extensions, leaves of absence, late add/drop, makeup exams, etc.), and medical school applications. Please feel free to contact me if you need to set up a meeting with Chip or need his signature on a form. I love having the opportunity to get to know Adams students and working to help them with questions ranging from tiny (room reservations) to immense (taking time away from College). When I'm not working, I love reading, walking, baking, listening to music and podcasts, and traveling with my family. I've been in Adams since March of 2018. Previously, I worked in a similar role at Harvard Business School, and also taught English at Suffolk University and the Wentworth Institute of Technology.
